Name: Rebel Abigail
Author: BoundNode
Description:
'[b][u]Rebel Abigail[/u][/b]' is a [b]Portrait[/b] and [b]Character Sprite[/b] replacer mod for Abigail.

This mod [b]only affects the visuals of the character[/b] and does not alter Dialogue or anything else.

It gives Abigail a Punky Emo Tomboy aesthetic (with black and purple leather outfit, piercings and a short hairstyle), and makes her taller.

All of her sprites have been updated (Default, Winter and Beach). She also has a custom 'white wedding suit' (instead of the wedding dress)

It should be compatible with any other mods (although if you have another mod that modifies the appearance of Abigail, ensure this mod loads above that mod)
